The '''Shinda Center''' was the largest shopping complex in the [[Expanse|Tapani Expanse]] and was located on [[Estalle Island]]. It was nearly two kilometers long with seven levels in some locations and hosted thousands of retail outlets. Many of the shops were outlets of exclusive establishments found in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]]. The Shinda Center was popular among the young [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani]] elite where they could find the latest Core world clothing fashions.
